input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Handle Ctrl+D gracefully in interactive prompts

Pressing Ctrl+D during an interactive prompt previously caused either
an unwrap panic or an infinite loop (the 0x04 byte was silently
ignored). This adds a UserCancelled error variant and handles EOF
at every prompt entry point:

- Custom yes/no and dumb-select prompts detect the Ctrl+D character
  (0x04 in raw mode) and return UserCancelled immediately.
- Dialoguer-based prompts (Confirm, Input, Select, MultiSelect) map
  UnexpectedEof IO errors to UserCancelled via map_dialoguer_err.
- The main error handler exits silently with code 130 on cancellation.
EOF
)"

input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Handle Ctrl+D gracefully in interactive prompts

Pressing Ctrl+D during an interactive prompt previously caused either
an unwrap panic or an infinite loop (the 0x04 byte was silently
ignored). This adds a UserCancelled error variant and handles EOF
at every prompt entry point:

- Custom yes/no and dumb-select prompts detect the Ctrl+D character
  (0x04 in raw mode) and return UserCancelled immediately.
- Dialoguer-based prompts (Confirm, Input, Select, MultiSelect) map
  UnexpectedEof IO errors to UserCancelled via map_dialoguer_err.
- The main error handler exits silently with code 130 on cancellation.
EOF
)"

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Handle Ctrl+D gracefully in interactive prompts

Pressing Ctrl+D during an interactive prompt previously caused either
an unwrap panic or an infinite loop (the 0x04 byte was silently
ignored). This adds a UserCancelled error variant and handles EOF
at every prompt entry point:

- Custom yes/no and dumb-select prompts detect the Ctrl+D character
  (0x04 in raw mode) and return UserCancelled immediately.
- Dialoguer-based prompts (Confirm, Input, Select, MultiSelect) map
  UnexpectedEof IO errors to UserCancelled via map_dialoguer_err.
- The main error handler exits silently with code 130 on cancellation.
EOF
)"

Handle Ctrl+D gracefully in interactive prompts

Pressing Ctrl+D during an interactive prompt previously caused either
an unwrap panic or an infinite loop (the 0x04 byte was silently
ignored). This adds a UserCancelled error variant and handles EOF
at every prompt entry point:

- Custom yes/no and dumb-select prompts detect the Ctrl+D character
  (0x04 in raw mode) and return UserCancelled immediately.
- Dialoguer-based prompts (Confirm, Input, Select, MultiSelect) map
  UnexpectedEof IO errors to UserCancelled via map_dialoguer_err.
- The main error handler exits silently with code 130 on cancellation.
EOF
)"
